create_conv_length_prediction_module: create a ConvLengthPredictionModule from config to predict sequence lengths using lightweight convolution layers
create_masked_length_prediction_module: create a MaskedLengthPredictionModule from config to predict sequence lengths using masked mean pooling
run_mean_pooling_on_tensor: run mean pooling on a batched tensor with optional padding mask to compute length-weighted averages
run_pool_operation_on_tensor: run mean, max, or none pooling on a tensor with optional encoder padding mask
review_conv_length_prediction_forward: review the ConvLengthPredictionModule forward pass that applies conv layers with residual connections and predicts length logits
